description: This file defines the JsonResponse class in the Laminas\Diactorosesponse namespace. It provides a way to create HTTP responses with a JSON payload, handling JSON encoding, headers, and response body creation. The class extends a base Response class and uses a trait for content-type injection.

classes.name: JsonResponse
classes.description: A class to facilitate creating JSON-formatted HTTP responses, including encoding data to JSON, setting appropriate headers, and managing response body content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new JsonResponse object with data that is JSON-encoded, sets HTTP status, headers, and content type.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload data that will be JSON-encoded in the response.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Returns a new JsonResponse instance with the specified payload data.

methods.name: getEncodingOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the current JSON encoding options.

methods.name: withEncodingOptions
methods.description: Returns a new JsonResponse instance with specified JSON encoding options.
